name: Brass Ship's Compass
description: A weathered brass compass salvaged from a coastal trading vessel, complete with its original gimbal mount and hinged glass lid.

name: Victorian Pocket Watch
description: Hand-engraved silver case pocket watch with a mechanical movement, still keeping time after more than a century.

name: Carved Oak Writing Desk
description: Solid oak writing desk with hand-carved legs, a leather inlay top, and three original drawers with brass pulls.

name: Porcelain Tea Set
description: Hand-painted floral porcelain tea set for four, gilded rims, minor age crazing consistent with the period.

name: Iron-Bound Trunk
description: Travel trunk reinforced with hand-forged iron banding, original leather straps, and a working lock and key.

name: Gilt Hand Mirror
description: Ornate gilt-framed hand mirror with a floral repoussé design and a beveled glass plate.
